name: shape_atlas_s1
type: exploratory build; not a phase, not a test
header_line: exploratory, hindsight used by design; nothing here is a tested result.

decisions.D39: S1 may describe F1-layer columns per post-tau type (docs/Universe-Decisions.md D39, Cooper 2026-09-27)
decisions.ticker_blocked_variant: section 4c's across-time check also runs ticker-blocked (Cooper 2026-09-27, recorded under D39)

views.instrument: equal-volume buckets, bucket VWAP, heights over sigma_path = sqrt(sum r^2) of the view's own bucket log returns (research/attention_excursion_b1/instruments.py::bucketize); tick-derived (D4)

post.span: prints strictly after tau up to the last print <= 20:00 ET; element 0 = tau price (b2's vector)
post.reuse_check: components rebuilt here must equal b2's t1_excursion.parquet (max abs difference <= 1e-9)

runup.span: prints in [segment start, tau] (segment start 04:00 / open + 60 s / close + 60 s, Amendment 3); element 0 = the first print in the span, buckets over the rest up to and including the tau print
runup.unavailable: tau in a cross minute (no segment start); no print before the tau print in the span; sigma_path zero
runup.thin: fewer than 250 prints in the span (flag, carried)

whole_day.span: first event-day print at or after 04:00 ET to the last print <= 20:00 ET; element 0 = the first print; tau marked as u_tau = share of the view's bucketed volume traded by the tau print

views.prior_close_axis: run-up and whole day also carried as log(bucket VWAP / prior close) on the same volume clock (prior close = Brief 1 T1 prior_close_exact)
views.gap_share: log(first event-day print at or after 04:00 / prior close) / log(1.30)
views.spike_guard: tau is b2's spike-guarded tau (3% / 3%); the paths are bucket VWAPs of every print, exactly as b2's post-tau vector

resample.grid: u_g = (g + 1) / G, g = 0..G-1, linear interpolation of the (N + 1)-point path on its own volume clock (u = i / N)
resample.height: (log p(u) - log p(0)) / sigma_path of the view

null.construction: per event, view and rung: draws with replacement of the event's own demeaned bucket log returns (N per draw), re-integrated from element 0 and passed through the identical component and resampling code
null.rng_stream: numpy default_rng([seed, event_index, view_code, N]); event_index = position in the event list sorted by event_id; view_code post 0, runup 1, whole_day 2; draws are taken row by row, so the first r draws of any request are the same draws
null.percentile: rise_pct = 100 x (count(null < real) + 0.5 x count(null == real)) / 200; fall_pct likewise
null.null_draw_percentile: a null draw's percentile is taken against the event's other 199 draws, same mid-rank rule
null.identity_test: a real path sent through the null pipeline with the identity index and no demeaning must give output identical to the real pipeline

theory_types.null_share: each event's 200 draws typed by the same rules; an event's null share of a type = the share of its draws in that type; the null share of the population = the mean over events

clustering.input: the G = 100 resampled sigma-normalised path per event; events with no path (unavailable, sigma zero) are their own class and not clustered
clustering.fpca: principal components of the resampled paths (uniform grid: functional PCA = PCA of the discretised curves); spectrum = explained-variance share per component, first 20

gmm.space: first d FPC scores, d = the fewest components reaching 90% of the REAL view's variance; the null uses its own FPCA with the same d
gmm.bic_gain: BIC(k) - BIC(1), so real and null compare the gain from mixture structure

silhouette.space: the resampled paths (Euclidean), for both methods

null_replicates.draws: null draws 0..4 of every event (each replicate is one draw per event, the same events as the real fit)

clustering.labels: cluster ids ordered by size, largest = 0
clustering.ari: adjusted Rand index between the GMM and k-means labels at each k (real and null)

stability.across_time: fit on A, assign B to the fitted model (k-means: nearest centre; GMM: A's FPCA projection then predict); fit on B separately; match A's and B's clusters by the Hungarian method on the correlation of member-mean paths; report matched correlations and type shares; then the reverse direction
stability.ticker_blocked: the same, with every ticker seen in the fit period removed from the assigned period

bootstrap.co_assignment: for each refit, every event is assigned; an event's co-assignment rate = the mean over refits of the share of its full-fit cluster-mates given the same refit label

structure_label._note: the brief names the three conditions; these operational cuts are S1's own, declared before the run
structure_label.beats_null: the real statistic exceeds every null replicate at that k: silhouette for k-means; silhouette and BIC gain for GMM
structure_label.reproduces: the cluster's matched centroid correlation >= 0.9 in both time directions (tickers repeating)

descriptors.u_launch: volume-clock position of the lowest point of the run-up path (element 0 included)
descriptors.height_s: (log tau price - log run-up low) / run-up sigma_path
descriptors.max_drawdown_s: largest (running max - path) inside the run-up, / sigma_path
descriptors.pushes: drawdowns of at least 1 sigma_b (= sigma_path / sqrt(N)) from the running max that are recovered (a new high above that running max) before tau
descriptors.duration: minutes from the first print in the span to tau; shares in the span

runup.transitions: run-up type -> post-tau type, counts and row shares, overall and by segment: declared classes -> theory types; declared classes -> post clusters (each method, k); run-up clusters (each method, k) -> theory types

gallery.closest_metric: Euclidean distance to the type's mean resampled path

atlas.band: pointwise IQR of members' resampled paths
atlas.null_centroid: mean of the members' null draw-0 resampled paths
money: excess_rise_bp = rise_bp - the event's own null median rise in bp at the same rung

attention: trades_per_min and dollars_per_min at rung 0 and at the finest valid rung
flow_share at L = rest of session, finest valid rung
competition excess as the crosser j: median over its live names, L = rest of session, W = 15 min, read cells

atlas.distribution_display: continuous: 41 quantiles (every 2.5%, min and max included) with n; categorical: share per level with n

type_by_date.statistic: chi-square of the date x type contingency table
type_by_date.null: type labels permuted across events (dates and per-date counts fixed)

joint_peak_rise.null: every event's 200 null draws, pooled with each event weighted equally

assertions: bucket volume conservation in every view (instruments.bucketize)
every resampled path has exactly G points
